settings.privacyModalSubtitle: Compliant with Sri Lanka Personal Data Protection Act No. 9 of 2022
settings.privacyModalBanner: SRIBEES Sri Lanka is fully committed to protecting your personal identity, delivery address records, and digital payment transactions under strict encrypted standards.
settings.privacySection1Text: We collect primary mobile numbers, customer delivery coordinates, rider notes, and purchase order histories solely to process SriBees Express grocery fulfillment and order dispatch.
settings.privacySection2Text: Under no circumstances do we sell, rent, or distribute customer information to telemarketing networks, external advertising brokers, or unauthorized third parties.
settings.privacySection3Text: You maintain the absolute right under PDPA No. 9 of 2022 to request full deletion of your customer profile, order log data, and saved address cards at any time via the Danger Zone on your account.
settings.privacySection4Text: Payment card credentials and bank gateway tokens are encrypted and handled directly by Central Bank of Sri Lanka (CBSL) approved payment switches.
